canonical_name: Poisson formula for the two-dimensional wave equation
canonical_statement: For c > 0, compactly supported f of class C^3 and g of class C^2 on R^2, every compactly supported classical solution u of u_tt = c^2 Delta u with u(.,0)=f and u_t(.,0)=g satisfies, for x in R^2 and t > 0, u(x,t) = d/dt [(t/(2*pi)) integral_{|z|<=1} f(x+c*t*z)/sqrt(1-|z|^2) dz] + (t/(2*pi)) integral_{|z|<=1} g(x+c*t*z)/sqrt(1-|z|^2) dz.
